title: Merge Triplets to Form Target Triplet
prompt:
You may repeatedly pick two triplets and replace them with their element-wise max. Return whether the `target` triplet can be formed.

**Example**: `triplets = [[2,5,3],[1,8,4],[1,7,5]]`, `target = [2,7,5]` → `true`.

A triplet is usable only if no component exceeds the target. Among usable triplets, check each target component is hit exactly by some triplet.

tests.note: no triplet reaches 3 in the first slot

hints: Any triplet with a component GREATER than the target is poison (max would overshoot) — ignore it.
Among the safe triplets, you need each of the three target values to appear in the matching position.
Track three booleans: did some safe triplet match target[0], target[1], target[2] exactly?

solution.explanation: Element-wise max never decreases a value, so any triplet exceeding the target in any slot can never be used. Restricting to safe triplets, merging them all is optimal — if each target component is matched by some safe triplet, their combined max is exactly the target. O(n).
